summary: If playbooks are missing from the Job Template list, make sure the playbook is valid YAML and that the awx user owns /var/lib/awx/projects (`chown awx -R /var/lib/awx/projects/`).
questions: Playbooks not showing in job template list
Why can't controller see my playbook?

answer_card.title: Playbook missing from job template list
answer_card.answer_md:
- Check the playbook is valid YAML Ansible can parse.
- Make the project path readable by `awx`:
```bash
chown awx -R /var/lib/awx/projects/
```
